periods.time: vol-09 ch-005, immediately before the D-block third-round match

name.zh: 珠雫与天音赛前准备室血案
name.en: Shizuku and Amane's bloody waiting-room incident

periods.location: Wangan Dome waiting room shown on the arena screen
periods.summary: When Shizuku and Amane fail to enter for their third-round match, the arena screen reveals a blood-soaked waiting room: Amane laughs covered in blood while Shizuku is pinned to the wall by many thin swords.
periods.cause: Shizuku was scheduled to face Amane, whose causality/luck power had already produced two nonstandard wins. Shizuku claimed to have a secret plan, but the actual clash occurs offstage before the public entrance.
periods.process: After Ikki returns from treatment and joins Stella in the seats, the third-round third match is announced. Neither Shizuku nor Amane appears. The commentators ask for the waiting-room camera feed, which shows the horrific scene instead of the expected pre-match preparation.
periods.outcome: Ikki screams Shizuku's name. The match's result and exact mechanics remain unresolved in this volume excerpt, but the scene announces the beginning of Ikki's nightmare semifinal against Amane.
periods.aftermath: The volume ends on the bloodbath cliffhanger, shifting the tournament from hard-fought matches to a personal crisis for Ikki.
periods.significance: Sets up Amane as Ikki's most personal and nightmarish next opponent and ends the volume on a major injury to Shizuku.
